conditions: Private GNOME compositor on the ROG Intel GPU. The virtual connector advertised PQ and BT.2020 for this fixture. 1280 by 800 at 60 Hz, 616 cd/m² peak, 203 cd/m² reference white. The viewer displayed six flat patches encoded independently as BT.2020. The screen recorder requested a single exact SPA format and shared-memory (MemFd) buffers. Each connection captured a complete frame directly, with no video converter.
failure_before_fix: A black pixel in a buffer negotiated as xRGB_210LE contained 0xff000000. In that layout red is 1008. The monitor shared-memory writer had used its native 8-bit ARGB readback for every format. The area and virtual-output writers passed the same constant. Detached repaint also allocated a default-precision texture.
scope: Digital screen capture of the monitor path. The session used a proof build linking the corrected source objects and a test-only virtual connector. Separate client connections exercised each format. Same-stream renegotiation, direct DMA-BUF capture and physical panel response were outside this measurement.
